title: Launch issue
sourceDocs: DTP TS tickets via Glean, Jun–Oct 2026

ln_err.text: What does the launch step show?

options.label: Hit engage button on steering wheel, nothing happens
options.issue: engage not confirmed or launch timed out

options.label: Software not of release / permission check

ln_pbt.text: Do the PBT reset, then retry launch
steps: Perform the PBT reset per [SOP](https://sites.google.com/aurora.tech/procedures/home-v2).
Retry the launch step.
ln_pbt.help: If launch still won't proceed after the PBT reset, the launch task needs a reset from a VRE.

ln_deploy.text: Confirm the software pull actually finished
steps: Check the software pull status in your tool.
If it finished, the launch task still thinks a deploy is running. That needs a VRE.

ln_ticket.text: Check the software on the VO ticket
steps: Confirm the [VO ticket](https://jira.int.aurora.tech/)'s Shipyard release matches the software you pulled.
If it doesn't, dispatch or the ticket owner has to fix it.

Wait for both PWR indicators on the LSI to slow-blink green.
Press the Compute Power Button for 1 second. PWR indicators fast-blink green, then burn steadily.

ln_cs.caution: Follow SOP for any vehicle state change before launch.
ln_cs.help: A vehicle command error on launch cleared with stack to IDLE, cold start, and retry (DTP-104301).

ln_esc_reset.text: The launch task needs a reset, which only a VRE can do. Open a TS ticket and paste the handoff.
ln_esc_reset.handoffNote: Likely request: reset the LAUNCH_VEHICLE task. Past causes: engage not confirmed in time after arming (DTP-100634), authorization nonce about 30 min old (DTP-111048). Operator will engage promptly after the reset.

ln_esc.text: Operator-level launch steps are used up. Open a TS ticket and paste the handoff.

ln_eng_check.text: Check doors, parking brake, and logging drives
steps: Open and close both doors, then check the door-open light on the dash is off.
Go back through the launch steps for the parking brake and standby button. A "park brake not ready" fault showed up in two of these tickets.
Check the logging drives are the right ones for this truck. Wrong drives blocked a launch with almost no visible error.
Confirm the tool still shows ready and no checklists have come back.
Open and close both doors, then check the door-open light on the dash is off. The door can read open while it's shut, so cycle both doors even if they look closed.
Go back through the launch steps for the parking brake and standby button. A "park brake not ready" fault showed up in two of these tickets.
Check the logging drives are the right ones for this truck. Wrong drives blocked a launch with almost no visible error.
Confirm the tool still shows ready and no checklists have come back.

ln_eng_retry.text: Retry in TApp and press engage again
steps: Tap Retry in TApp to re-arm the launch.
Slide to launch, then press the steering-wheel engage button within 60 seconds.
Press it firmly and hold for about a second. A very short press may not register.
If nothing happens, let TApp time out before pressing standby to try again. A standby press drops the truck to manual.

ln_esc_eng.phrase: Ready state, engage press does nothing, launch timed out. Related: DTP-113311, DTP-114429.
details: Say whether you heard a rejection chime.
Give the time of the engage press.
If TApp still shows the failed launch step, ask for a task reset.
ln_esc_eng.text: Engage still does nothing after a retry and a cold start. Escalate to VRE and paste the handoff.
